what: Deterministic Python script that reads live state and produces the operator inbox — every figure is a measurement taken at runtime, never stored. Sections ordered by expected-emptiness: totals, troubles, email, adjudications, questions, design, tickets, intentions, ideas. Runs as a cairn verb (cairn operator_inbox). Replaces the whatslefttodo LLM skill.
why: Because the operator should be able to run one command and see everything that needs attention, with zero stale figures. The old LLM skill re-derived the inbox from scratch every time, could invent counts, and stored data it read — this script cannot report stale data because it stores none. Akien, 2026-08-27: 'this skill should just run a script. and that script should produce the same output... this isn't for CC to prepare in a skill every time from scratch. this is for deterministic python.'
how_it_learns: It does not learn — it reads. Each reader calls the source's own API (TroubleDevice().live(), pending_findings(), filesystem globs) and the script assembles the results. A new data source is a new reader function added to the script, not a learned behavior.

laws.law_1: The script retires the re-derivation of the inbox — the resolver is spent on the novel, not on re-deriving the settled.
laws.law_3: Every figure in the output is a live measurement. An unmeasured claim would be a section reporting from stored data.
laws.law_10: The script's output IS the observation — every recorded observation is measurement.

the_naming: 'Operator' not 'Akien' — multi-operator future. 'Adjudications' not 'findings' — findings has two meanings in the system (a finding is also a learning_block record). Section order is a ruling from the 2026-08-27 session: expected-emptiness puts troubles and email at the top.
